positions.note: IDEALISED: positions and (for 'auto') the threshold-resolution tracer are the simulator's own truth, not solved from a completed search's max-likelihood model (the SLaM chained-fit convention). 'auto' = max(auto_factor * max_sep(truth positions, truth tracer), auto_minimum_threshold); truth positions trace to ~zero separation through the truth tracer by construction, so 'auto' collapses to the auto_minimum_threshold floor for every Stage-1 dataset.
